mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand weakness, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, the Fed is tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS and 20-day SPX returns is not positive (e.g., correlation < 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110.0, it signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS > 0.5% MoM) signals robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 0.5%.
